resources.string: Ready to open the Google app. This release does not use a Discover bridge.
Google Discover feed
Swipe outwards from the first page. Uses the Google app already on your phone. Opens it if cards cannot appear here.
Experimental and unofficial; may stop working after updates.

Google provides the feed, its network access and personalization. Chikku tries to show cards here using an unofficial interface. Google only lets debuggable or system apps show cards on a home screen, so normal Chikku builds need the optional Chikku Discover bridge app for that. Without it, the swipe opens the installed Google app. If the bridge stops working, Chikku tells you why, such as battery settings blocking it. Google or Android updates may change whether cards can appear here.

The Chikku Discover bridge isn\'t starting. Your phone\'s battery or app-sleep settings are probably blocking it. In the bridge\'s app info, set battery use to Unrestricted, and remove it from any sleeping, deep sleeping or auto-launch restriction list.
